privacy:
This privacy policy explains how ICOM Switzerland processes personal data on the website of the 19th International Bodensee Symposium. It is based on the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) and, where applicable, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Controller

ICOM Switzerland – International Council of Museums, Swiss National Committee
Konradstrasse 14, 8005 Zurich, Switzerland
info@museums.ch

Visiting this website

When you visit this website, our hosting provider automatically processes technical data such as your IP address, the date and time of access, the page requested and your browser type. This is necessary to deliver the website and to protect it against misuse. The website is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., USA).

We do not use cookies, analytics or tracking tools. The fonts are served from this website; no data is sent to font providers.

Contact form and email

If you contact us via the form or by email, we process the information you provide (name, email address, organisation and message) in order to answer your enquiry. Messages sent via the form are transmitted through the service Formspree (Formspree, Inc., USA) and delivered to our mailbox. We keep your message only as long as necessary to deal with your enquiry.

Registration

Registration for the symposium takes place on the EMYA2027 website (emya2027bern.com). The privacy policy of that website applies. To organise the symposium, the registration data of symposium participants may be shared with ICOM Switzerland and the co-organising committees ICOM Germany and ICOM Austria.

Livestream, documents and external links

The livestream and some documents may be provided via external platforms. When you follow a link to another website, the privacy policy of that website applies.

Transfers abroad

Some of the service providers named above are based in the USA. Where personal data is transferred there, this is based on appropriate safeguards, such as the Swiss-U.S. and EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses.

Your rights

You have the right to request information about your personal data and to have it corrected or deleted. You may object to its processing and, where applicable, request data portability. Please contact us at info@museums.ch. You can also lodge a complaint with the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC) or, if you live in the EU, with the data protection authority in your country.

Changes

We may update this privacy policy. The current version is always published on this page.
